summary: Owned XP and level ledgers with deterministic linear curves, multi-level grants, capped levels and pending game-defined level rewards.
useWhen: Track lifetime/current XP, complete multiple levels atomically and let the game decide what each level reward is.
limitations: Linear base + growth curve only. It does not own perks, stat changes, UI, persistence or automatic reward selection.
Consumers call consumeLevel after applying their own level reward; the provider never applies gameplay effects.
